messages:
Alex: AM check — quick snapshot: 42 open tickets (12 high). Notable: Microlane partner surge (~ML-238) and embeddings errors spiked in eu-west-1 overnight.
Maria: on it — pairing with infra to investigate embed pipeline. If kernel rollback needed, ETA ~2h.
Sam: I'll own the three tickets waiting on an engineer, prioritizing external-facing ones. List: #ML-236, #ML-238, #ML-241.
Jen: FYI I updated a macro for embed incidents called `embed-degraded`. Added explicit fallback + customer msg.
Jen: Macro snippet below (for copy/paste):
```
1) /support macro run embed-degraded
2) flush KV cache: `redis-cli -h embed-cache FLUSHDB`
3) switch model: embed-serve:v2 -> embed-serve:v1-fallback
4) notify customer with macro: embed-pulse-notify
```
Alex: Can someone run the flush? I don't have access from my laptop.
triage-bot: Alert created — embeddings.error_rate > 5% for tenant `microlane`. Incident INC-2026-17 opened and linked to #ML-238.
Maria: Running KV flush now, will paste small log excerpt when done.
Sam: Pinged @eng-infra for kernel revert; asked for priority patch. :eyes:
Jen: Repro note from QA: failures mostly with long docs (>8k tokens). Added that to macro and ticket descriptions.
Alex: Blocker for closing high-priority: waiting on infra rollback confirmation for KV config. Otherwise CS replies can be sent using the new macro.
Maria: KV flush done — evicted ~6k keys, sample logs: `evicted 6123 keys in 3.2s`. Error rate dropping to ~2.1%.
Sam: Good sign. If infra confirms kernel revert, I'll close/merge the customer-facing replies and update statuses.
Jen: Small housekeeping — will rename macro to `embed-degraded-v1` to avoid confusion before I open the PR.
Alex: Thanks all. Quick asks: Sam pls follow up with CS on the three open customers, Maria pls monitor error rate for the next hour, Jen pls open the macro PR. I'll ping on slack if anything urgent changes. :thumbsup:
